scope: Promote four further parameterized families of contraction-minimal nonlearning partial cubes built from crossed subcubes: the full-cap, decorated singleton-aq, double-half-wing, and collared-cap families.

source_preservation.policy: The database owns the normalized family definitions, parameter restrictions, orders, repair certificates, contraction-minimality claims, and concise proofs. The survey retains the complete proofs, construction narrative, notation, figures, and comparison among the continuation families.
source_preservation.recoverability: The exact source hash and proposition locators preserve the complete scholarly context.
source_preservation.mutation: No source file in PartialCubes or another sibling repository was modified.

validation.website: Normalized 1339 generated HTML files; 12 tables and 2 graph views pass.
validation.graphs: 184 Hasse covers represent 230 stored inclusions; all 22 minor-atlas Ample-family nodes remain covered; all 114 classes have an audited position relative to Partial Cubes; 234 closure-map arrows render.
validation.migration: All extractors, source-preservation checks, bibliography and coverage audits, class-status audits, and review-queue validation pass.

deferred: These records assert contraction-minimality only; they make no pc-minimality or completeness claim because learning-space graphs are not closed under convex restrictions.
The subcube-scaffold, staircase q-cap, and punctured-triangle continuation families remain queued for exact promotion.
